text:
alex: quick check — we have 4 demo rack slots in us-west2 pending rollover for Thurs 09:00 demo. vendor X says invoices are on hold, did procurement get a PO release? :eyes:

sasha: yep saw vendor note this morning. procurement is waiting on finance signoff, they flagged a mismatch on the invoice amount.

procurement-bot: Invoice INV-789 flagged: 'amount mismatch'. Waiting for PO release from fin-ops. Link: https://invoices.internal/redwood/INV-789

maria: if PO isn't out by EOD we should petition to keep the slots. can we temporarily tag them as `standby-rollover` so they don't get reclaimed by autoscaler?

devinfra-bot: autoscaler reclaim cutoff for the rack pool is 2024-09-19T11:00Z (rollover window). Tagging would need a terraform change + apply.

alex: thanks — PR ready, just needs a couple reviews. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/582

maria: nice. what's the minimal change? can we avoid full pool update?

alex: add `lifecycle = { prevent_destroy = true }` on the demo slot resources + a tag. small plan, but still an apply to the pool namespace. snippet:

```hcl
resource "redwood_demo_slot" "thursday_demo" {
  count = 4
  pool  = "us-west2-demo"
  tags  = ["standby-rollover"]
  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }
}
```

tj: if finance doesn't release, we can borrow 2 from the standby pool for the demo and carve them back after. cost delta ~ $120/hr, FYI.

fin-ops: PO hold is on our side. pushing release now, should clear by 6401234600. will update here when done.

procurement-bot: Vendor acknowledged hold; will hold slots until 2024-09-19T12:00Z before automated reclaim.

sasha: if fin-ops clears before 12:00 we can go with alex's PR. otherwise tj's standby borrow is the fallback.

alex: plan: 1) wait for PO clearance (fin-ops) 2) if cleared -> merge PR + apply 3) if not -> tj to issue standby borrow and I'll update demo runbook. agreed? :+1:

maria: agreed. i'll ping oncall if apply is needed outside regular window.

fin-ops: PO released at 6401234605, vendor confirmed receipt. all green.

alex: awesome — will merge infra PR and schedule apply in the 10:00 maintenance window. I'll post apply logs here.

devinfra-bot: queued terraform apply for infra#582 in workspace 'us-west2-demo' — run id tf-run-909. Will post status updates.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short note in #general after the apply completes.
